name: happyhorse-1.0-video-edit
description: HappyHorse 1.0 Video Edit is an AI video editing model for intelligent transformation and enhancement of existing videos. It supports style transfer, object replacement, frame completion, defect repair, and automatic subtitle or voice-over generation while preserving the original motion, composition, and temporal consistency. The model helps simplify post-production workflows and is suitable for video remixing, creative editing, style conversion, and professional content refinement.
zhDescription: happyhorse-1.0-video-edit 是面向已有视频的 AI 智能编辑模型，支持风格迁移、物体替换、画面补全、瑕疵修复、字幕与配音生成等视频二次创作能力。模型的核心优势是在编辑过程中尽量保留原始视频的运动轨迹、画面构图和时序连贯性，适合视频风格化、内容改写、素材修复、营销视频再创作和后期制作效率提升场景。
longDescription: HappyHorse 1.0 Video Edit is an AI video editing model for intelligent transformation and enhancement of existing videos.
